blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA– LeBron James had 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds for his first triple-double with Philadelphia, and Tyrese Maxey scored 30 points to lead the 76ers to a 111-104 victory over the Miami Heat in an NBA Cup game Wednesday night. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 32 points and 14 rebounds for Miami, and Davion Mitchell scored 20 points. READ: LeBron James moves to 3rd on NBA career assist list The 76ers played a second straight game without Joel Embiid (illness), and Jaylen Brown was ruled out after the first half with left hamstring tightness.
